[[File:Sunn-Childe_cave.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The M'usts learn from Cody Sunn-Childe]]
'''M'usts''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of subterrestrial-dwelling [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from a [[M'ust homeworld|homeworld]] that was conquered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="marvel46">[[Star Wars (1977) 46|''Star Wars'' (1977) 46]]</ref> in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The M'usts had a religious culture that worshiped an eternally burning flame beneath their planet's surface, and generally followed a simple, peaceful way of life. After the Imperial conquest of their world, the M'usts came across [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] warrior [[Cody Sunn-Childe]], who shocked the natives by becoming the first to survive immersion in their holy flame. The M'usts thus took Sunn-Childe to be their [[Flame-God|god]], and worshiped and supported the [[Jashwik]] as he learned their peaceful philosophy and how to command his newly awakened psychic abilities.<ref name="marvel46" />

==Behind the scenes==
M'usts first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 46|''Star Wars'' (1977) 46]], written by [[John Marc DeMatteis]] and released in [[1981]]. In the comic, they were illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]].<ref name="marvel46" />
